t_advice_summary_textbox.text: One of the gnomes gives higher rewards than the other from each pair - to get the most, work out which it is and choose that one. At some point during the game it will swap. If it swaps for one pair, it will swap for all pairs.

vb_textbox.text: You will see pairs of gnomes. The pairs always come in the same set of colours (red/yellow or blue/purple for example). One consistently gives a higher reward than the other in each set. Once you have worked this out you can choose that gnome each time. During the game, the gnome which gives the highest rate swaps. If you notice that a gnome isn't giving the higher rate any more, swap to the other gnome. If one set of gnomes has swapped, they all swap at the same time. For example, if red was giving you the higher number of mushrooms, but suddenly changed to yellow being higher, you would also swap for blue/purple. Remember to account for the number of mushrooms when you decide which is higher.
